commit: fix(javascript): avoid linebreaks in embedded template interpolations

truth.description: printTemplateExpressions now maps only the expressions key, but printTypescript in typescript.js still sends every TSTemplateLiteralType, whose interpolations live under types, through printTemplateLiteral into it, so formatting a TypeScript template literal type such as type Key = `on${string}` throws a TypeError on reading length of undefined.

distractions.why: printTemplateExpression now returns each expression already wrapped in its own ${ and }, so the jest each table renders the docs as they are instead of adding the braces a second time.
